stops.note: 'son of Adam', a Gaelic patronymic surname
after John Loudon McAdam of Ayr, whose 1816 Remarks on the Present System of Road Making laid out roads of compacted small stones; tar-bound 'tarmac' was patented by Edgar Purnell Hooley in 1902

current_meaning: a road surface of compacted broken stone, often bound with tar
